## Summary

This repository is **not actively maintained**. It was built as a personal learning project and is shared as-is — the code is here for anyone to read, fork, modify, and use freely under the MIT License (see [LICENSE](../../blob/main/LICENSE)). No ongoing support, no guaranteed responses to issues/PRs, no promise of updates for future game patches or Windows versions. If it breaks for your setup, you're welcome to fix it yourself — that's the whole point of it being open source.
